One additional repo https://github.com/Instadapp/fluid-deployments also surfaced but not fetched.

Base — Messari source notes DEX protocol is NOT deployed on Base (only Lending/Vault); zero DEX addresses from fetched sources. DexLite router at 0xBbcb91440523216e2b87052A99F69c604A7b6e00 (Ethereum) surfaced from docs integration example code. DEX pools deployed via CREATE opcode (factory nonce-based addressing, not standard factory enumeration view). Full factory address not yet surfaced; factory children enumeration deferred to next run once factory address is discovered. Role taxonomy applied: FLUID token (token class), DexLite router (router class). Factory, admin, governance, treasury, and timelock addresses not yet surfaced.

protocol_metadata.about: Fluid DEX is a decentralized exchange built by Instadapp (rebranded from Instadapp in late 2024) on top of the Fluid Liquidity Layer — a unified liquidity primitive shared across lending, vaulting, and DEX protocols. Users swap tokens through DEX pools (type T1) deployed via CREATE opcode and identified by integer dexId; a DexLite variant offers a simplified single-contract swap interface. The protocol's key innovation is that vault collateral and debt positions simultaneously serve as DEX liquidity, maximising capital efficiency across all three protocol types.
